items.front: How many princely states in 1947 & their three options?
items.back: ~565 states; each could accede to India, accede to Pakistan, or stay independent.
items.examPoint: 565 princely states & the three options (Accede to India/Pakistan/Independence)

items.front: Who led integration & what did the Instrument of Accession cede?
items.back: Sardar Patel + V.P. Menon (States Department); Instrument ceded defence, external affairs & communications.
Junagadh (plebiscite Feb 1948), Hyderabad (Operation Polo Sept 1948), J&K (Instrument of Accession 26 Oct 1947, Hari Singh; Article 370).
items.examPoint: Junagadh integration (Nawab's accession to Pakistan; plebiscite Feb 1948)

items.back: Dhar (1948) rejected language; JVP (1948, Nehru-Patel-Pattabhi) advised delay; Fazl Ali/SRC (1953) accepted language as a factor.
Andhra State, 1 Oct 1953 (capital Kurnool), after Potti Sreeramulu's fast-unto-death (died 15 Dec 1952).
items.examPoint: Potti Sreeramulu & Andhra State 1953 — first linguistic state

items.back: Based on Fazl Ali Commission; created 14 states & 6 UTs; enacted with the 7th Constitutional Amendment.
1 Nov 1956, merging Andhra State with Telugu areas of Hyderabad State under the Gentlemen's Agreement (1956).
items.examPoint: Andhra Pradesh 1956 (Gentlemen's Agreement) & Puducherry transfer (1954/1962); privy purses abolished 1971 (26th Amendment); Sikkim 1975 (36th Amendment)

items.back: Goa liberated from Portugal via Operation Vijay (1961), statehood 1987; Puducherry transferred by France (de facto 1954, treaty 1962).
Air India nationalised 1953 → Imperial Bank→SBI 1955 → Kerala Communist govt (EMS) 1957 → Goa 1961.
items.examPoint: Early nation-building milestones chronology (Air India 1953, SBI 1955, Kerala Communist govt 1957, Goa 1961) & Hind Mazdoor Sabha 1948

items.back: Ashok Mehta, T.S. Ramanujam and G.G. Mehta (socialist trade union).
items.examPoint: Early nation-building milestones chronology (Air India 1953, SBI 1955, Kerala Communist govt 1957, Goa 1961) & Hind Mazdoor Sabha 1948

items.back: Privy purses abolished 1971 (26th Amendment); Sikkim became 22nd state 1975 (36th Amendment).

items.front: First PM & President of the Republic?
items.back: Jawaharlal Nehru (PM); Dr. Rajendra Prasad (President). Constitution in force 26 Jan 1950.
items.examPoint: Adoption of Constitution 1950 & Nehru as first PM (consolidation context)
